author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Effects master Greg Nicotero tours Adam through his personal collection of creature puppets and sculptures in his KNB EFX offices! Among them is the original life-size werewolf puppet from The Howling (1981), which established the modern design of the bipedal werewolf creature in film. Here's how KNB EFX's artists worked with the restoration team at Tom Spina Designs to revive this classic movie monster. 

Learn more about the restoration of this creature: https://www.tomspinadesigns.com/restoration/horror-movie-props/the-howling-life-sized-werewolf-prop-restoration-2/
Learn more about KNB EFX's work at https://www.knbefx.com/

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
Additional media courtesy KNB EFX Group
